places.name: Casa Caña
places.description: Studio Allston's vibrant on-property restaurant and lounge featuring bold tropical tiles, street tacos, Latin-inspired plates, craft margaritas, and a lively patio.

places.name: Charles River Speedway
places.description: Restored 1899 courtyard marketplace minutes from the hotel housing Super Bien empanadas, The Koji Club sake bar, Pizza Project, Rite Tea & Espresso, and rotating pop-ups.

places.name: Notch Brewing & Biergarten
places.description: Award-winning session lager brewery and sunny brick courtyard beer garden inside the Speedway complex, pouring Czech-style pilsners and European classics.

places.name: Sloane's
places.description: Warm, intimate Lower Allston restaurant and cocktail bar serving seasonal New England comfort dishes, standout burgers, and house cocktails.

places.name: Lulu's Allston
places.description: Cult-favorite Allston hangout known for inventive comfort plates, loaded mac & cheese, weekend brunch, and one of the best rotating craft beer lists in the neighborhood.

places.name: Lone Star Taco Bar
places.description: Beloved Allston institution serving Baja-style street tacos, warm queso, and top-shelf mezcal and tequila cocktails late into the evening.

places.name: The Rail Stop Restaurant & Bar
places.description: Polished neighborhood brasserie and whiskey bar in Boston Landing serving wood-grilled steaks, raw bar classics, and seasonal New England fare.

places.name: Widowmaker Taproom & Kitchen
places.description: Industrial-chic Brighton brewery pouring hazy IPAs and crisp lagers alongside flatbreads, wings, and weekly vinyl and trivia nights.

places.name: Studio Allston Art Collection
places.description: Explore original large-scale murals, lobby installations by Jason Woodside, custom elevator art by Kenji Nakayama, and curated works by over 20 local and national artists right inside the hotel.

places.name: Herter Park & Charles River Path
places.description: Scenic riverside walking and jogging path steps from Studio Allston, winding along the Charles River past kayaking docks and the seasonal Riverstage amphitheater.

places.name: Zone 3 & Western Ave Murals
places.description: Lower Allston's creative corridor showcasing rotating street art murals, artist workshops, experimental pop-up galleries, and neighborhood activations.

places.name: Harvard ArtLab & Allston Campus
places.description: Striking timber-and-glass interdisciplinary arts studio and modern pedestrian plaza right across Western Ave, hosting public artist showcases and outdoor installations.

places.name: Harvard Art Museums
places.description: Three historic museums united under a soaring glass roof just across the Charles River, featuring Monet, Van Gogh, Warhol, and contemporary exhibitions. Free admission.

places.name: Boston Landing & The TRACK
places.tagline: Live Music, Athletics & Beer Hall Hub
places.description: Brighton's lively modern hub home to Roadrunner concert hall, New Balance's indoor track arena, Bruins practice rink, and Broken Records Beer Hall.
